items.title: Meta Ads: $361.32 spend, 29 leads, $12.46 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: This branch's most recent prior meta-ads.json is run_at 2026-09-08 (window ending 2026-09-07), older than the 7-day lookback cap, so this run widened to the maximum --days 7, covering 2026-09-17 through 2026-09-23 rather than the standard single day. Over that window Meta spent $361.32, all on the sole actively-delivering campaign (Flooring Problems Campaign), generating 29 leads at $12.46 CPL — below the prior-week baseline (2026-09-10 to 2026-09-16: $354.40 / 21 leads, ~$16.88 CPL), so no CPL anomaly. Account is ACTIVE, no ads are flagged DISAPPROVED/WITH_ISSUES.

needs_attention: Ingest gap: the last successful meta-ads.json on this branch was run_at 2026-09-08 (window ending 2026-09-07), 16 days before today — older than the 7-day lookback/widen cap. Today's pull used the maximum allowed --days 7 (2026-09-17 through 2026-09-23), so 2026-09-09 through 2026-09-16 (8 days) remains uncovered by any daily-ingest run and cannot be backfilled under the standard procedure's cap.

Recurring lead-action-type overlap: Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again show lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads=29, offsite_search_add_meta_leads=29, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads=29 — each exactly matching the 29 counted leads), consistent with prior runs on 2026-08-31, 2026-09-02, and 2026-09-07/08. No discrepancy in the counted total, but this recurs across 5+ consecutive runs now — the script's lead-action set should be extended rather than continuing to hand-note it.
